author.name: NR TECNOLOGIA E SOLUCOES JURIDICAS LTDA

description:
TribuJus connects ChatGPT to a collection of real Brazilian court decisions. Search by topic or context, retrieve available full texts, and find judicial reasoning and excerpts to support legal drafting, with links to official sources.

Access judgment statistics where available, accompanied by methodological notes and coverage limitations. When a text or data is unavailable, that limitation is reported.

Coverage varies by court and period. View current coverage at tribujus.com.br/mcp.

defaultPrompt: Busque acórdãos sobre dano moral por negativação indevida, com links para as fontes oficiais.
Encontre acórdãos sobre atraso reiterado de salários e leia o inteiro teor para destacar fundamentos sobre rescisão indireta.
Consulte a jurimetria de dano moral no TJRO e explique os resultados, a cobertura e as limitações dos dados.
